ExtraDock 4.2.7 – Smarter, Smoother & Fully Backed Up! 🛡️✨

✨ What's New

  • Accessibility Banner: A friendly banner at the top of the settings window makes enabling Accessibility a breeze!
  • Window Switching: Right-click any app to switch between its open windows — with context for multi-window apps!
  • Custom Folder Stack Icons: Folder Stacks now support custom icons — personalize every corner of your dock!
  • Automatic Configuration Backups: ExtraDock now keeps backup copies of your dock setup and lets you restore or reveal them from Settings!

⚙️ Settings

  • Auto-Hide Reveal Delay: Choose how long you have to hover at the edge before a hidden dock pops out!

⚡ Improvements

  • Smarter Auto-Hide: Auto-hidden docks now only appear when you touch the edge of the screen, with a customizable delay!
  • Spacer Widget: Now supports custom spacing configuration that goes up to 3000 pixels!
  • Divider Widget Spacing: The Divider widget now has a built-in spacing option — no more need for extra Spacer widgets!
  • Space Awareness: Now uses deeper macOS Space information, making it more reliable across displays and Spaces!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Spacer Widget Cleanup: Removed a stray divider-like pixel line from the Spacer widget!
  • Launch Animation: Fixed to be more consistent across all dock positions!
  • Dock Size Controls: Reverted to the previous style — fixes a bug where icons randomly changed size!
  • Live Dock Wake-Up: Clicking an app now properly brings it front or minimizes it, depending on your settings!
  • Backup Export: Exporting configuration backups now uses the proper default save behavior!
  • Respect Dock Space: Now waits until startup positioning is finished before kicking in — no more launch-time window pushing!
  • Live Dock Deduplication: Collapses duplicate app icons when the same app is already manually added to the same dock!
  • Smarter App Clicks: Apps with no real open window now open a new window instead of getting stuck on invisible ghost windows!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraDock more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraDock community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
